source.note: The code as it stood on the fork’s main branch when the recovery started (25 Oct, 19:31 UTC). The run itself used a commit made on the run host and never published, built on this one.

ticks: Session ticks, as the runner counted them from the recovery login; the replay numbers ticks the same way.

steps.name: R1 recovery receive
steps.plain: Back in Lumbridge after the death, take the rebuilt kit from a helper by trade: the cannonballs, the potions and the food.
steps.codeNote: A one-off recovery script, reviewed and run pinned by its hash; it is not part of the fork.

steps.name: T26-27 Ardougne teleport + lever + keep web + run
steps.plain: Teleport to Ardougne, pull the lever into the deep Wilderness, cut through the web and run to the poison spiders.

steps.name: S27 combat finish
steps.plain: Set the cannon down under the poison spiders and fight beside it until Defence, Ranged and Hitpoints are 99: melee first, then the scimitar, then the magic shortbow.

steps.name: T27-17 run to the ridge gate + ridge + run to the pipe
steps.plain: Run north to the ridge gate, cross the ridge and run to the pipe at the start of the Agility course.

steps.name: agility:wilderness
steps.plain: Lap the Wilderness Agility Course until level 99. The agility program runs each obstacle, eats on landing and watches for other players.

steps.name: agility:final-logout
steps.plain: Wait for the level-up messages to close, step clear of any fight, and log out: the run is over.
